module: Entry point of the "Game Engine" Lua VM (GE, vmType = 'game'). The C++ engine loads this file at startup then calls its global functions (onGameEngineStartup, init, update, luaPreRender, clientPreStartMission, vehicleSpawned, onExit…). Each one generally relays the event to the extensions via extensions.hook('onXxx', ...). A modder almost never calls these functions: they listen to the corresponding hooks in their extension (onUpdate, onPreRender, onClientStartMission, onVehicleSpawned…). They do use setExtensionUnloadMode, loadPresetExtensions, unloadAutoExtensions, returnToMainMenu and endActiveGameMode, however.
usage:
-- GE extension (lua/ge/extensions/monmod.lua)
local M = {}
local function onInit() setExtensionUnloadMode(M, 'manual') end -- survives level changes
local function onUpdate(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw) end -- called from update() in main.lua
local function onPreRender(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw) end -- called from luaPreRender()
local function onVehicleSpawned(vid, veh) end
M.onInit, M.onUpdate, M.onPreRender, M.onVehicleSpawned = onInit, onUpdate, onPreRender, onVehicleSpawned
return M
notes: File load order (top-level): vmType='game', package.path, require luaCore and common/cdefs, definition of log/print (log -> Lua:log, print -> log('A','print',...)), then mathlib, utils, devUtils, ge_utils, luaProfiler, StackTracePlus (replaces debug.traceback), then the global modules below.

Modules loaded and exposed as globals by main.lua: Point3F (= vec3), json, guihooks, screenshot, simTimeAuthority (backward-compatible alias bullettime), WinInput (= Input), extensions (paths lua/ge/extensions/ and lua/common/extensions/), map, settings (= extensions.core_settings_settings), perf (utils/perf), spawn, setSpawnpoint, serverConnection, server (server/server), commands (server/commands), editor (empty table; if PlatformSwitches.useEditor is false: editor.isEditorActive returns false and editor.toggleActive does nothing), parseArgs (client/parseArgs), MoveManager (empty table), sailingTheHighSeas, photoModeOpen=false, levelLoaded=nil, worldReadyState=-1, logAlways (= print), doStartupProfiling. gameConnection=nil (backward compatibility, getGame() returns it).

Startup order: (1) file load; (2) C++ calls onPreStart() (empty) then onGameEngineStartup() which creates the settings/ and screenshots/ folders, the 'MainEventManager' EventManager, parseArgs.defaultParseArgs(), client/core initializeCore, client/init initClient, PhysicsPlugin.init, posts the 'onStart' event, then loads a level passed on the command line ($levelToLoad) via core_loadMapCmd; (3) init(reason) loads the startup extensions (startupExtensions); (4) on the first frame updateFirstFrame(); (5) the UI calls uiReady(). In the code read, the exact caller of init is not in this file: the comment says it is also called on reload (Ctrl+L), reason being 'startup' or 'reload'.

Update loop: update(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw) is called every frame after the inputs and before the physics. It does: menu music fade, settings.settingsTick, core_input_bindings.updateGFX(dtRaw), simTimeAuthority.update(dtReal), onUpdate hook, handling of unstable vehicles, then (only if be:getUpdateUIflag()) onGuiUpdate hook and sending of the UI streams (guihooks.sendStreams), perf.update(), tryCompleteLuaReload. luaPreRender(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw) is called just before rendering and after the physics: map.updateGFX(dtReal, dtSim), onPreRender hook, onDrawDebug(Lua.lastDebugFocusPos, dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw) hook, then the end-of-loading detection (worldReadyState).

Order when loading a level: clientPreStartMission (worldReadyState=0, onClientPreStartMission hook, UI 'PreStartMission') -> clientPostStartMission ('freeroam' game state by default, onClientPostStartMission hook) -> clientStartMission (onClientStartMission hook, then map.assureLoad()). worldReadyState goes to 1 (value set by code outside this file, not seen here); in luaPreRender, when player vehicle 0 has its materials ready (or after 5 s of cumulative dtRaw), the loading screen is dismissed, worldReadyState=2 and the onWorldReadyState(2) hook is emitted. At the end: clientEndMission emits onClientPreEndMission, stops the physics simulation, removes the pause then emits onClientEndMission.
Units: dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw in seconds (dtSim is the simulated time, accounts for slow motion/pause; dtRaw is the raw time).

Extensions: the startupExtensions are all in unloadMode 'manual' (never unloaded on level change). The presetExtensions (core_environment, core_weather, gameplay_traffic, gameplay_parking, core_groundMarkers…) are loaded by loadPresetExtensions() when setting up a game mode. The others are in 'auto' mode and unloaded by unloadAutoExtensions().

Physics instability: onInstabilityDetected enables the vehicle's ghost mode and teleports it in place for 1 s (instabilityDetectionTime); a second instability during this delay deletes the vehicle. A hook onInstabilityDetected(vid, returnData) lets an extension handle the case itself by setting returnData.instabilityHandled = true.
Bug/inconsistency: physicsEngineEvent(...) does "local args = unpack({...})": only the first value is kept and passed to the onPhysicsEngineEvent hook.
Bug/inconsistency: onInstabilityDetected calls v:getJBeamFilename() before testing "if v"; if the vehicle no longer exists, the function crashes (the guard further down is useless).

Bug/inconsistency: validatePrefabJson computes newPath without using it; loadModScriptsRec is local, never called in this file; handleCommandLineFirstFrame and loadRequiredExtension are local (inaccessible to extensions).

Obsolete functions: loadGameModeModules and registerCoreModule log "OUTDATED MOD CODE" and are due to disappear; use unloadAutoExtensions()+loadPresetExtensions()+extensions.load(...) and setExtensionUnloadMode(M,'manual').

Test/debug functions (test_prefabv2, load_test_prefabv1/2, test_spawn_prefabv2, test_spawn_prefabv2_massive, test_unload_prefabv2, load_spawn_prefabv2_indirect, runMimalloc_test, convert*/validate* prefab): development tools callable from the console.

log.desc: Global replacement of log: forwards all arguments to Lua:log (level 'D','I','W','E','A', origin, message).

print.desc: Global replacement of print: writes via log('A','print', tostring(...)). Only the first argument is converted and logged.

ConsoleInputCallback.desc: Empty global callback for the imgui console; an extension can redefine it to receive the input.

getGame.desc: Backward compatibility: returns the global gameConnection, which is nil (no longer a scene object).

isSafeMode.desc: Indicates whether the game was launched with the command-line argument -safemode.

returns.desc: key found in the arguments (truthy) or nil

convertPrefabtoJson.desc: Dev tool: loads a .prefab (TorqueScript) prefab at the origin, saves it as .prefab.json then unloads and deletes it.

convertLevelPrefabs.desc: Dev tool: finds all *.prefab / *.prefab.json under levelPath and calls convertPrefabtoJson on each.

validatePrefabJson.desc: Dev tool: reloads a .prefab.json and saves it again in the same place (format normalization).

validateLevelPrefabs.desc: Dev tool: calls validatePrefabJson on each *.prefab.json of levelPath.

convertCStoJson.desc: Dev tool: runs TorqueScript scripts (.cs), detects the created objects and saves them in the new JSON format via a PersistenceManager, then deletes the objects (except SimSet/SimGroup).

newExtSuffix.desc: not used in the function body

prepareStartupExtensionsList.desc: If PlatformSwitches.useEditor is true, adds editor_main and editor_veMain to the startup extension list; recomputes the list of manual-unload extensions. Called by init().

unloadAutoExtensions.desc: Unloads all extensions except those in 'manual' mode (extensions.unloadExcept). Call when changing game mode/level.

loadPresetExtensions.desc: Loads the presetExtensions list (+ those requested on the command line via queueCmdlineLevelLoadExtension), then empties this command-line list (single use).

setExtensionUnloadMode.desc: Defines whether an extension survives level changes ('manual') or can be unloaded automatically ('auto', default). Logs an error if the extension or the mode is unknown.

extension.desc: module M (its __extensionName__ is read) or extension name

endActiveGameMode.desc: Disconnects from the local server (serverConnection.disconnect, asynchronous state machine) then, in the callback, unloads all non-manual extensions and calls callback.

callback.desc: called once the mode has finished

queueCmdlineLevelLoadExtension.desc: Adds an extension to load at the next loadPresetExtensions (used for extensions requested on the command line).

setMainMenuMusicKeepAlive.desc: Forces the main menu music to continue (true) or hands control back to the per-UI-route logic (false). Does nothing if the state does not change.

setMainMenuMusicPauseRequest.desc: Registers or removes a menu music pause request identified by requestId, then refreshes the state.

returns.desc: false if requestId is invalid, otherwise true

setMainMenuMusicRouteState.desc: Applies the music logic according to the UI route: requested pause > keepAlive > 'menu' route (resume) > level loaded (stop with 0.6 s fade) > 'menu.credits' route (ui_credits extension) > 'menu.uiSounds' route (pause) > resume.

routeName.desc: name of the current UI route

refreshMainMenuMusicRouteState.desc: Reads the current route from ui_router.getCurrent() and calls setMainMenuMusicRouteState.

clientPreStartMission.desc: Called by the engine before the level resources are loaded. Sets worldReadyState=0, records the action, emits onClientPreStartMission(levelPath) and the UI event 'PreStartMission'.

clientPostStartMission.desc: Called when the level and the vehicles are loaded (after clientPreStartMission). Sets the default 'freeroam' game state (core_gamestate) then emits onClientPostStartMission(levelPath).

clientStartMission.desc: Called when the level objects are loaded (after clientPostStartMission). Stops the menu music (except keepAlive), emits onClientStartMission(levelPath) via hookNotify, then map.assureLoad() and empties the Sim cache.

clientEndMission.desc: Called at the end/unloading of the level. Emits onClientPreEndMission, stops the physics simulation (be:physicsStopSimulation), removes the time pause, then emits onClientEndMission(levelPath).

returnToMainMenu.desc: Leaves the active game mode (endActiveGameMode) and requests the default game state (main menu). The callback is called when the level is unloaded and a new one can be loaded.

callback.desc: called once the level is unloaded

editorEnabled.desc: Called by the engine when the editor is enabled/disabled (and on the first frame). Emits onEditorEnabled(enabled) and informs map via map.setEditorState.

requestGeluaProfile.desc: Called by the C++ when a performance log is wanted: creates a LuaProfiler for the next frame (update + luaPreRender), enabled in the extensions.

luaPreRender.desc: Called every frame by the engine, just before rendering and after the physics. Order: map.updateGFX, onPreRender(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw) hook, onDrawDebug(Lua.lastDebugFocusPos, dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw) hook, then, if worldReadyState==1, waits for the player vehicle's materials to be ready (max 5 s) to dismiss the loading screen, set worldReadyState to 2 and emit onWorldReadyState(2).

checkFSErrors.desc: Once per session: reads Engine.Platform.getFSInfo(); if an error is reported, displays an error toast in the UI and logs an installation corruption message.

updateFirstFrame.desc: Called by the engine on the first frame. Emits onFirstUpdate, settings.finalizeInit(), synchronizes the editor state, processes the first-frame command-line arguments (-flowgraph, -compilemeshes, -convertCSMaterials, -deps, -disableDynamicCollision, -enablemcp, etc.) and calls uiReady() directly with -noui or in headless mode.

update.desc: Called every frame by the engine, after the inputs and before the physics. See notes: settingsTick, core_input_bindings.updateGFX, simTimeAuthority.update, onUpdate(dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw) hook, handling of unstable vehicles, and if the UI must be refreshed onGuiUpdate hook + sending of the guihooks streams.

uiReady.desc: Called when the UI is ready. Emits onUiReady and marks the UI as ready for the finalization of a Lua reload.

isLuaReady.desc: Lets the UI know whether init() has finished.

returns.desc: true once init() has run to completion

init.desc: Initializes the GE VM at startup and on reload (Ctrl+L): initSettings, reserves _tr, enables detectGlobalWrites, loads the startup extensions (+ util_materialHotReload on Windows), opens the online session, importPersistentData, requests the UI state (guihooks 'isUIReady'), calls core_modmanager.onUiReady(), map.assureLoad(), creates the mods and trackEditor folders, then luaReady=true.

reason.desc: 'startup' or 'reload'; copied into the global luaVmStartReason

onBeamNGWaypoint.desc: Called by the engine when a vehicle crosses a BeamNG waypoint (scene object). Calls map.onWaypoint then emits onBeamNGWaypoint(args).

args.desc: waypoint data (structure provided by the C++)

onBeamNGTrigger.desc: Default callback function name of the BeamNGTrigger on the C++ side; emits the onBeamNGTrigger(data) hook.

data.desc: trigger data (structure provided by the C++)

onFileChanged.desc: Called by the engine when watched files change. Calls settings.onFilesChanged and map.onFilesChanged, emits onFilesChanged(files), then for each file onFileChanged(filename, type), finally onFileChangedEnd.

physicsEngineEvent.desc: Relays a physics engine event: onPhysicsEngineEvent hook. Only the first argument is passed on (see notes).

vehicleSpawned.desc: Called by the engine when a vehicle appears. Invalidates the vehicle caches, sets the vehicle's gravity (core_environment.getGravity), then emits onPreVehicleSpawned(vid, veh) then onVehicleSpawned(vid, veh). Does nothing if the object does not exist.

vehicleSwitched.desc: Called when the player switches vehicle. Emits onVehicleSwitched(oldId, newId, player) (id -1 if absent) and the UI event 'VehicleFocusChanged'.

onSetClusterPosRelRot.desc: Asynchronous callback when a vehicle's node cluster is teleported; emits onSetClusterPosRelRot(vehicleID, cNodeId).

vehicleReset.desc: Asynchronous callback after a vehicle reset; emits onVehicleResetted(vehicleID).

vehicleActiveChanged.desc: Called when a vehicle is activated/deactivated (e.g. traffic pooling). Unrelated to the player's vehicle switch. Emits onVehicleActiveChanged.

onMouseLocked.desc: Called when the cursor is locked/unlocked; emits onMouseLocked(locked).

vehicleDestroyed.desc: Called when a vehicle is deleted: forgets its instability timers, emits onVehicleDestroyed(vid), invalidates the vehicle caches.

onCouplerDetach.desc: Triggered when the user deliberately detaches a trailer's coupler; emits onCouplerDetach(objId, nodeId).

onAiModeChange.desc: A vehicle's AI mode has changed; emits onAiModeChange.

newAiMode.desc: new AI mode (inferred from the name)

onAiRouteDone.desc: The AI has finished its route; emits onAiRouteDone(vehicleID).

openXRStateChanged.desc: Forwards to render_openxr.stateChanged if this module exists.

openXRErrorDetected.desc: Forwards to render_openxr.errorDetected if this module exists.

replaySpawnVehicle.desc: Called by the replay engine to recreate a vehicle at (0,0,0); the player is installed in it only if they do not have a vehicle yet. If there is only one enterable vehicle, switches to the game camera.

CEFTypingLostFocus.desc: Called by the C++ when the CEF input field loses focus; relays the UI event 'CEFTypingLostFocus'.

exportPersistentData.desc: Before a Lua reload: serializes the extensions' packages (serializePackages), levelLoaded and the music source id into be.persistenceLuaData.

importPersistentData.desc: Inverse of exportPersistentData, called at the end of init(). On a deserialization error, logs and writes persistentDataError.txt.

physicsStateChanged.desc: The physics simulation is paused/resumed. Relays the UI event 'physicsStateChanged' then emits onPhysicsUnpaused (val true) or onPhysicsPaused.

val.desc: true if the physics is running

updateTranslations.desc: Unmounts mods/translations.zip if mounted, downloads locales_v2.zip via core_repository.installMod, then reloads the settings.

enableCommunityTranslations.desc: Enables the communityTranslations setting then launches updateTranslations().

onScreenKeyboardClosed.desc: The virtual keyboard is closed; emits onScreenKeyboardClosed(applied, text).

onInstabilityDetected.desc: Called by the physics engine when a vehicle is unstable: logs the nearby vehicles (< 1 m), displays a UI message, emits onInstabilityDetected(vid, returnData), then, if not handled, puts the vehicle in ghost mode and teleports it in place; a 2nd instability within the second deletes the vehicle.

onSpawnError.desc: Vehicle creation error: logs and displays an error toast in the UI.

sendUIModules.desc: Sends to the UI ('onUIBootstrap' event) the list of the folders in /ui/modModules/; empty list on error.

loadDirRec.desc: Recursively loads the materials of a folder: first *materials.cs (TorqueScript), then *materials.json, then *datablocks.json.

onPreStart.desc: Entry point called by the engine before onGameEngineStartup; empty body.

onPreWindowClose.desc: Called before the window closes; emits onPreWindowClose.

onPreExit.desc: Called before the game exits; emits onPreExit (profiled).

onExit.desc: Called directly by the C++ on exit: emits onExit, disconnects the server, destroys PhysicsPlugin, posts the 'onExit' event of the MainEventManager, then settings.exit().

onGameEngineStartup.desc: Called once by the engine at VM startup: creates the settings/ and screenshots/ folders, the 'MainEventManager' EventManager, parses the command line, initializes the core and the client (client/core, client/init), PhysicsPlugin, then loads the $levelToLoad level if any via core_loadMapCmd (deferred until the mod manager is ready).

onLuaReloaded.desc: Called after a Lua reload (Ctrl+L): client/core reloadCore, client/init reloadClient, measures the duration and arms the reload-completion tracking.

reloadStartTime.desc: os.clockhp() at the start of the reload (s)

onLuaReloadModManagerCompleted.desc: Signals that the mod manager has finished after a Lua reload.

onLuaReloadCompleted.desc: Logs the total reload duration and clears luaReloadStartTime. Called by tryCompleteLuaReload when jobs, settings, UI, mod manager (and MCP) are ready.

onTexDrawPrimCompressDone.desc: A drawn texture is compressed; emits onTexDrawPrimCompressDone(textureName).

updateLoadingProgress.desc: Updates the UI loading bar ('UpdateProgress' event) and forces a Canvas repaint while a level is loading; stores $lastProgress and $$lastProgressTxt.

updateTSShapeLoadProgressDynamic.desc: Uses updateTSShapeLoadProgress if defined (editor loaded), otherwise updateLoadingProgress.

loadGameModeModules.desc: OBSOLETE: unloadAutoExtensions() + loadPresetExtensions() + extensions.load(...) with error logging.

test_prefabv2.desc: Dev test: builds SimGroup and TSStatic objects in MissionGroup then deletes thePlayer, spawn_default, ParticleEmitter.

test_spawn_prefabv2.desc: Dev test: instantiates 'test_v2' at (6,3,2), scale 1.5, 45° rotation around Z.

test_spawn_prefabv2_massive.desc: Dev test: instantiates count random copies of 'test_v2' in MissionGroup.

load_spawn_prefabv2_indirect.desc: Dev test: spawnPrefab of test_v2.prefab.json via spawnPrefab.
